answer: In an agent marketplace, an agent selling yarrow, forecasting a zephyr, or appraising a relic gets governance votes in proportion to collateral locked for 30 days. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities still yields only 100 tokens' worth of votes, so fake accounts add no power. To gain influence, an attacker must acquire and lock more collateral, tying up capital and bearing its price risk for the full lock period.
